features: High Quality, Less Odor & Less Warping- Numakers premium PETG filament is produced using high-quality PETG resin developed specifically for 3D printing filament. Our special formulation leads to minimal odor and low warpage during printing. Enclosed chamber is required for better quality and durability when printing big parts with PETG filaments.

Easy-to-Use, Clog-Free & Bubble-Free- Special precision oscillating strand guide technology guarantees tidy and tangle-free winding. Filaments are dried before packaging to ensure a smooth and stable printing experience.
Wide Compatibility - 1.75mm PETG filament compatible with practically all desktop 3D printers, including Monoprice, Ender 3, Airwolf, Ultimaker, Makergear, Lutzbot, Flashforge and many more.
Dimension Accuracy & Consistency - Fully automated closed-loop diameter measuring and self-adaptive control system in the manufacturing process ensures strict diameter tolerance of +/- 0.05 mm.
Wallet Friendly - Economies of scale and improved production efficiency allows NUMAKERS PETG filament to be cost-effective and wallet-friendly without compromising on quality.
